prompt: Phase 09 Prompt 24 — Retrieval Quality Eval Set
objective: Create source-linked retrieval evaluation cases from approved outputs — metadata-only, fail-closed, read-only by default.

summary.migrator_change: None — reuses the existing V38 eval_sets + eval_cases tables; schema stays 38, contract table count stays 190.
summary.embeddings: None — the eval set is pure metadata enumeration of approved outputs (no semantic embedding).

eval_set.source: Approved outputs: approved Obsidian generated outputs + reviewed/accepted long-term memory, enumerated via vector_index._gather_approved_nodes.
eval_set.case_per_node: One source-linked eval case per approved node, admitted iff it carries a source_ref + an allowlisted (non-excluded) source_family. eval_case_id = hash(set_id:family:source_ref); expected_source_ref_hash = hash(source_ref) (hashed — never the raw ref); question_hash = hash(family:source_ref:retrieval) (a deterministic query seed hash — no raw query text); confidence_class from the node.
eval_set.eval_set: eval_set_id = res_<set_hash[:32]>; name_hash = hash(name) (set name hashed, never raw); case_count; review_tier summary (e.g. max=2;tiers=1,2); status built/empty.
eval_set.read_only: emit_receipt defaults False (no operator-DB write); receipt persistence (eval_sets + eval_cases, metadata-only, guard-clean) exercised in the proof on a temp DB.
eval_set.deferred: Executing/scoring the eval set against the index (eval_runs + pass/fail) is a later prompt.

operator_db_outcome.rationale: The operator DB has no approved Obsidian/reviewed-memory outputs -> the set is honestly empty. emit_receipt defaulted False -> no persist.
